summary: Verified Compartir (WhatsApp) button on private OrderTracking page (/order-tracking/:orderId). Login as cliente@nubotest.com worked; got real order_id from GET /api/orders; navigated to private tracking page; share-tracking-btn is visible, green (#25D366 / rgb(37,211,102)), labeled 'Compartir', and clicking it invokes window.open with a wa.me URL containing /track?order=<orderId>. Order details, status timeline, items and chat sections render correctly.

issues: Google Maps fails to load: 'ApiTargetBlockedMapError' shown as 'Oops! Something went wrong.' inside DeliveryMap. Pre-existing (not part of this change) — Google Maps JS API key restriction. Worth reporting to main agent.

action_items: Investigate Google Maps 'ApiTargetBlockedMapError' on /order-tracking — API key referer/domain restrictions likely block preview domain (pre-existing, not blocking the share button feature).
WebSocket wss://.../api/ws/tracking/<id> handshake fails on preview env (pre-existing infra; tracking falls back gracefully).
critical_code_review_comments: OrderTracking.js handleShare() correctly uses window.location.origin + /track?order=${orderId} and encodes via encodeURIComponent — matches public /track route verified in iteration_15.
Share button uses data-testid='share-tracking-btn' and explicit WhatsApp brand color (#25D366) with proper hover state — good.

Minor: wsUrl = API.replace('http','ws').replace('https','wss') — second replace is a no-op because the first already converted 'https' to 'wss' (replaces the 'http' substring). Not introduced by this change but worth noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Share button on private tracking page (iteration_16) verified end-to-end: visible, clickable, opens wa.me with /track?order=<orderId>. Pre-existing Google Maps API key restriction + WebSocket /api/ws/tracking handshake error remain on preview env but do not affect the share feature.
